beats.label: The setup
beats.text: **31** adults, 60 to 75. About **2** handfuls a day for **16** weeks.
beats.note: Kerkhof, Joris et al., Food & Function 2026 (Maastricht UMC)

beats.label: What shifted
beats.text: Memory areas like the **hippocampus** responded **better** to insulin.

beats.label: Why it's interesting
beats.text: Brain insulin signaling is **thought** to help **protect** memory.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Only **31** people. Funded by a **peanut** group. Brain scans, **not** dementia.
